description: Multi-vendor CCTV recorder (DVR/NVR) forensic log extraction and analysis workbench
changes: Config Backup decodes Dahua XVR/NVR configuration backups (MWPZWJGS) with no export code needed.
The payload is MD5-verified, which also identifies the device family (HCVR, XVR or NVR); nothing is written unless it verifies and unpacks safely.
Extracted configuration files with pretty-printed JSON copies and a SHA-256 manifest.
Tested with an HCVR5104C-S3 (V3.218 firmware) and an 8-channel XVR.
Config Backup: opens a Hikvision configuration backup and recognises it before the export code is known.
With the export code: verified decoding of every section into a new folder with a SHA-256 manifest; nothing is written unless every section decodes.
Without the export code: a hashcat mode 26401 hash line with ready-to-run commands, copy and save.
Tested with Hikvision firmware 4.x and later; for older firmware see WormChickenWizard/hikvision-decrypter and rafayahmed317/hikvision-decryptor on GitHub.
Initial public release of CCTV Log Analyzer, the successor of HikvisionLogAnalyzer.
Reads raw/DD images (including split sets), EnCase E01 images and read-only physical drives.
Identifies Hikvision, Dahua and TVT recorders from on-disk structures; iCatch disks are identified, but no usable logs were found on them.
Hikvision RATS log carving with SDK event mapping and payload decoding.
Dahua XFS database extraction with a normalized UTC timeline and plain-language field explanations.
TVT mlogtype record parsing with original types, SDK type interpretation and parsed payload fields.
Recovered record bytes and absolute image offsets in the record details window.
Case folders with a unique workspace per run, manifest and UTC audit log.
Byte-accurate progress and cooperative cancellation of long extractions.
Search, per-column, category, source-database and mlogtype filters with SQL pagination.
Date filter initialised to the earliest and latest valid log times of the evidence.
Short summaries in result rows; full details, text and bytes in the record details window.
Hikvision Security Audit, Camera / Motion and Log Statistics views.
Read-only entropy survey for unrecognized images.
CSV export and multi-page HTML reports with record, field and log-type selection.
Physical Drive Administrator check with Restart as Administrator and evidence-disk safety checks.
System, Dark and Light themes with configurable fonts.
Windows installer for the current user or for all users.
